product.title: Red Rock Canyon Luxury Tour Trekker Experience
product.description: Travel in premium Trekker-style comfort from Las Vegas to Red Rock Canyon with a luxury-forward format focused on scenic access and expert interpretation. The route follows the conservation area's signature loop and major geological overlooks so travelers get both elevated comfort and meaningful desert context.
highlights: Luxury Trekker vehicle format with guide-led interpretation.
Drive the Red Rock Canyon Scenic Loop with curated stops.
See layered sandstone geology and Mojave vistas just outside Las Vegas.

itineraryItems.title: Luxury Trekker Pickup in Las Vegas
itineraryItems.description: Board a premium Trekker vehicle and review the day's route, safety notes, and geology focus.

itineraryItems.title: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Loop
itineraryItems.description: Travel the scenic loop road with guided interpretation of Aztec Sandstone, faulting, and Mojave ecology.

itineraryItems.title: Calico Hills / Overlook Stop
itineraryItems.description: Pause for panoramic views and short walks to appreciate layered red formations.

itineraryItems.title: Visitor Area and Return
